description: Implementation of WNMapView class handling map rendering, user interaction, and notifications in a game scenario editor.

classes.name: WNMapView
classes.description: Custom NSView subclass for rendering and interacting with game maps, handling user input, and updating display based on game state.

methods.name: acceptsFirstResponder
methods.description: Indicates the view can accept first responder status to receive key events.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Sets window to accept mouse moved events when view becomes first responder.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Disables mouse moved events when view resigns first responder.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Initializes notification observers, cursor images, tracking rects, and other setup after loading from nib.

methods.name: drawRect:
methods.description: Renders the map, terrain, units, and cursor based on current game state and zoom level.

methods.name: drawAt:mapPoint:zoomed:
methods.description: Draws terrain and units at specified point, considering zoom level.

methods.name: displayUnitsAtPoint:mapPoint:forDifficulty:
methods.description: Displays units of specified difficulty at given point.

methods.name: isFlipped
methods.description: Returns YES to indicate coordinate system origin is at top-left.

methods.name: mapTabSelected:
methods.description: Handles tab selection changes, updating tracking rects and responder status.

methods.name: mapRestoreTracking:
methods.description: Restores mouse tracking rects after tab change.

methods.name: mapChanged:
methods.description: Updates view size and display when map data changes.

methods.name: mouseDown:
methods.description: Handles mouse click events for terrain and unit placement or removal.

methods.name: mouseMoved:
methods.description: Tracks mouse movement, updates map info display, and posts notifications.

methods.name: mouseDragged:
methods.description: Handles mouse drag events by calling mouseMoved.

methods.name: mouseEntered:
methods.description: Handles mouse entering view area, updating responder status.

methods.name: mapInfo:
methods.description: Updates map info display elements based on notification data.
